moves.detail: Rivals rewards landed at 08:59 (EA: Thursdays 06:59 UTC). Hero and DFG cards still lead FUT.GG's fallers (Undav DFG 87 −16%, Scott Hero 85 −14%), so wait before buying older specials. Spend on fodder first.
moves.title: Don't chase specials after the rewards

moves.detail: 81–84s all still sit on FUT.GG's 650 floor (15:28), but an 84 carries 830 Item Score on FUTBIN against 410 for an 83. That's 0.78 coins per point, the cheapest score in the game. Any 84 works for Streamlined SBCs. Tracked call: entry recorded at 650 (FUT.GG, 10:29); graded Friday 17:00. Selling only pays above 684 after the 5% tax.
moves.title: Buy 84-rated fodder at 650 or less

moves.detail: New promo teams open in packs at 18:00 UK on Fridays (19:00 in Zurich), which pulls coins away from older specials. Example: DFG Isak is 495K on FUTBIN Thursday morning, down from 609K on Wednesday evening, and DFG cards lead FUT.GG's fallers. This is for spare cards only: keep the ones you play Champions with, since selling and rebuying costs the 5% tax. Follows the checked tip rule: sell spares only.

moves.detail: 85s beat 84s as fodder once they fall under about 1,645 (now 1,900). 86s are already close at 0.85 coins per point, so use them if the 84 floor runs dry.

verdict.detail: At 15:28 FUT.GG still shows the 81–84 floor at 650, 85s at 1,900 and 86s at 3,500, unchanged since the 08:59 Rivals rewards. FUTBIN's Index 100 is 116.43 (+1.3%) with momentum about 50 ("chillin"). Buy 84s while they sit at 650; the next demand point is Destined for Glory Team 2 on Friday at 19:00.
